picks.editorial_note: A nearly $24.5M NIA renewal sustains a multi-year academic-clinical center applying AI to aging and Alzheimer's care, one of the largest funding commitments of the week with direct public-health impact.
picks.title: UMass Amherst and Mass General Brigham Awarded Nearly $24.5M for 5-year Continuation of MassAITC | UMass Amherst

picks.editorial_note: A cross-institution team (MIT, CMU, NYU, Stanford) built an AI system that beat top human players at Stratego, a landmark for imperfect-information game AI with algorithmic implications beyond games.
picks.title: This game-playing AI is the new champ at Stratego

picks.editorial_note: An $8M federal grant package will expand AI education and workforce training infrastructure, strengthening the talent pipeline that underpins broader AI research capacity.
picks.title: UCR receives $8 million in federal grants

picks.editorial_note: A Harvard Kennedy School 'pre-mortem' report on catastrophic AI risk, citing real incidents like rogue-agent breaches and a major lab's training pause, adds urgency to the AI safety policy debate.
picks.title: Is it already too late to reduce catastrophic AI risk? — Harvard Gazette

picks.editorial_note: An AI-enabled biochip offering rapid, low-cost pre-screening for cancers and other diseases could meaningfully expand diagnostic access in resource-limited settings.
picks.title: AI-enabled biochip for rapid cancer, disease detection | The American University in Cairo

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair AI-generated 3D models before fabrication, addressing a key reliability gap in generative design pipelines.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: A new CRADA between Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory pairs space-based AI inference with weather-modeling expertise, a notable industry-federal lab collaboration with national-security relevance.
picks.title: Sophia Space and MIT Lincoln Laboratory announce research collaboration on space-based weather modeling

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's machine learning tool estimates past radiation exposure from a routine blood test, offering a faster, more accessible alternative to specialized biodosimetry with emergency-response applications.
picks.title: A Simple Blood Test Could Reveal Hidden Radiation Exposure

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern researchers showed AI models can flag precancerous colon lesions invisible to the human eye, a concrete clinical application that could improve early cancer detection.
picks.title: AI is helping pathologists find harmful lesions the eye can’t see

picks.editorial_note: Inria's voice-analysis decision-support tool for detecting heart attacks during emergency calls points to a practical, life-saving use of AI in time-critical medical triage.
picks.title: Samu-Voice: Analyzing voice and speech to detect acute transmural myocardial infarctions
